commands_run: clan read human doc.clan | Select-String '<(section|div|main|body|h1|h2)[^>]*' (structure probe)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ..\snapshots; Copy-Item doc.clan ..\snapshots\02-risk-analyst.clan -Force; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ..\receipts

files_read.path: doc.clan via 'clan read agent' (context.md + data.yaml TOON + decision chain)
doc.clan via 'clan read human' (structure-only grep of tags)

problems_and_friction: No protocol was provided, but 'clan agent-help' gave a compact, accurate command reference, so discovery cost one extra command. The only ambiguity: 'clan patch-data' printed a 'human view is stale - clan render to refresh' hint, but the human view is hand-authored full-html, so rendering risked clobbering it; I deliberately skipped render and patched the HTML directly with patch-html instead. Knowing where to inject HTML required probing the rendered DOM for a stable selector (div.wrap) since no selector map is documented.
context_understood: doc.clan held stage-1 market research (3 CRMs, EUR pricing, ad-ops fit, preliminary ranking HubSpot > Zoho > Salesforce) for Brightline, a 40-person Dublin ad agency; my job was to add the risk analysis (GDPR/residency, lock-in/exit, migration, hidden costs, support, plus a severity-rated risk register) into the artifact for the lead-partner's final recommendation.
